title: platanthera whangshanensis
intro: Platanthera whangshanensis, commonly known as the Whangshan Orchid, is a species of orchid native to China. It is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. The health benefits of Platanthera whangshanensis include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been reported to have potential therapeutic effects on cardiovascular and neurodegenerative diseases. The bioactive constituents of Platanthera whangshanensis include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions such as vasodilation and neuroprotection.
